test_runs.scope: small synthetic crypto/storage functional tests only

checks: v1 store and restore remain compatible
v2 SM2 key envelope wraps per-video key material and restores exact source bytes
v2 manifest HMAC rejects modified metadata before publishing plaintext
wrong expected video ID and wrong recipient key ID fail closed
modified chunk authentication fails and removes the partial restore file
rewrap to a distinct SM2 key preserves chunk ciphertext and leaves the source object readable
file-backed batch journal records a failure and resumes the object without reprocessing a completed object
indicator evaluator keeps formal metric outcomes unchanged and reports the v2 prototype as partial
scope_note: Correctness prototype evidence only. It does not prove production KMS lifecycle, global old-key invalidation, object-store durability, large-scale performance, or cross-library SM2 interoperability.
